source_note: Second demo procedure, added to prove the pipeline generalizes beyond the DGX H100 fan-replacement demo — exercises COUNT and MUST_NOT constraint types the first demo never triggers.
procedure: Server Fan, Power Supply and Cover Installation

events.label: fan_connected
events.description: A fan module's power connector plugged in before the fan is pressed into its slot

events.label: fan_installed
events.description: A fan module pressed fully into one of its slots

events.label: psu_installed
events.description: A power supply pressed into its compartment until the latch clicks

events.label: cover_installed
events.description: The server cover placed on top of the chassis and the black latch pressed until it locks

events.label: cover_forced_without_latch
events.description: The server cover pressed down hard without the latch clicking or locking

requirements.statement: Connect a fan's power connector before pressing that fan into its slot
All six fans must be installed
requirements.quote: All six fans must be installed

requirements.statement: Both power supplies must be installed
requirements.quote: Both power supplies must be installed

requirements.statement: Install the fans before installing the power supplies
requirements.quote: Install the fans before installing the power supplies

requirements.statement: Install the power supplies before installing the server cover
requirements.quote: Install the power supplies before installing the server cover

requirements.statement: The server cover must be installed and locked with the black latch
requirements.quote: The server cover must be installed and locked with the black latch

requirements.statement: Never press the cover shut without hearing the latch click
requirements.quote: Never press the cover shut without hearing the latch click
